# Sthala

> Open-source governed AI runtime placement reference framework for commodity x86 hardware. Airgapped by default. Core constraint: LLMs narrate, code computes — enforced at build time.

Sthala is a reference implementation of the Context Stack. It applies ContextOps and ContextBoundary to governed runtime placement.

ContextOps and ContextBoundary are the specification layer. contextboundary-gw, Sthala and Griha are reference implementations that apply it.

The composition is defined once, in COMPOSITION.md: https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack/blob/main/COMPOSITION.md

License: Apache 2.0. Status: v0.1 Alpha.

## Core

- [SPEC.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/Sthala/blob/main/SPEC.md): Architecture and six-layer pipeline specification
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/Sthala/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Machine-readable build contract for LLM coding agents; also the primary human-readable developer guide
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/Sthala/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Agent briefing
- [README.md](https://github.com/kannanokannan/Sthala/blob/main/README.md): Project overview

## Related projects

- [context-stack](https://github.com/kannanokannan/context-stack): Canonical terminology, locked decisions, and family framing
- [ContextOps](https://github.com/kannanokannan/ContextOps): AI context governance framework
- [ContextBoundary](https://github.com/kannanokannan/ContextBoundary): Egress governance specification for AI data flows
